rows.evidence: Q1: Sections 2.2-3 report the authors' own field sampling of 210 points at five depths over four seasons (autumn 2015 to spring 2017) in Qapqal County rice fields, ECe measured on saturated-paste extracts, and 3-D kriging maps built from these data (Tables 1-3, Figures 3-7).
rows.notes: The study contains no drip irrigation. It maps seasonal soil salinity (ECe) in flood-irrigated rice fields (soil nearly saturated May-August, Section 4.2) in a cold semiarid valley, finding salt accumulation from spring to autumn, dispersion from autumn to spring, accumulation in topsoil and deep subsoil, and microtopography/drainage as the main control. It does not test or observe drip systems, nor irrigation water quality effects, so it provides no own evidence that salinization occurs under drip. The passage's reference to Liu et al. (2020) is a technology mismatch.

notes: Full text appears complete. Study is a geostatistical mapping case study of soil salinity in surface-irrigated rice paddies in Xinjiang; it is not about drip irrigation.
